fees.label: Electrical permit — confirm on the Jan 2, 2026 schedule
fees.citation_note: Ordinance 2025-11-4, effective Jan 2, 2026. Commercial electrical inspections are by floor area. $75 on that schedule is the first reinspection, not a permit total. Do not publish a single electrical total.

gotchas.title: Plano electrical permit fee — 2026 sync
checklist: Confirm the electrical line for this job on Ordinance 2025-11-4 (effective Jan 2, 2026)
Do not use $75 as the electrical permit total — on that schedule it is the first reinspection
anti_patterns: Using a sister-city (Frisco/Allen) fee as Plano

gotchas.title: Plano rough → service → final sequence
checklist: Confirm service/meter equipment inspection when applicable
Hold final until AHJ checklist items are closed
anti_patterns: Skipping rough and hoping final covers it

gotchas.title: Fees + permit path must be reconfirmed before bid
checklist: Verify with Plano Building Inspections / Development Services before locking contingency
Do not invent dollar amounts for fees not on the official schedule

gotchas.title: Confirm trade application type early
checklist: Electrical vs general building path — confirm with Building Inspections
anti_patterns: Assuming one permit path covers all trades
